bio_am: Տարօնի պաշտպան հայդուկապետ, 1904-ի Սասնոյ ապստամբութեան ղեկավարներէն։ Ինկաւ Սուլուխի կռուին մէջ՝ 1907 Մայիս 27-ին։
bio_en: Gevorg Chavush was the legendary fedayi leader of Taron and Sasun. With Andranik he led the fedayi who seized the Arakelots monastery in 1903 and, with Andranik, Hrayr, Sebouh and Smbat, the Sasun uprising of 1904; afterwards he returned with Korium from Aghtamar to keep up the fight in the mountains, and young fighters such as Sasuntsi Manuk and Moruk Karo served at his side. From 1906 he worked with Ruben Ter-Minasian in Taron. On 27 May 1907 he and Ruben with 17 fighters were surrounded by troops and police at Sulukh; charging the enemy with characteristic daring, he was killed, and the authorities buried him near Gurgen's grave.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Birth year not stated in the archive texts read. Droshak published his full biography in 1907 (nos. 8-10), not in the archive. Poem #4 (folk song) concerns him.
